artifacts.summary: 10-phase plan converting 68 in-scope inline specs/state.json write sites across 16 core skill/command files to state-write.sh calls, then updating 6 stale-idiom documentation files. Phase 1 captures the gate-set baseline and establishes the conversion template on the smallest file; phases 2-8 own disjoint file territories (parallelizable), isolating the three files that interleave out-of-scope specs/archive/state.json and vault writes (task.md, todo.md, skill-todo/SKILL.md) into their own interface-tier phases; phase 9 updates docs last so examples reflect the actual final call shape; phase 10 executes the verification bar unweakened.

memory_candidates.content: When a mechanical conversion task spans many sites across files where in-scope and out-of-scope targets are visually similar and interleaved in the same code blocks (e.g. specs/state.json vs specs/archive/state.json writes), isolate each such file into its own plan phase with a mandatory pre-edit two-column inventory (in-scope vs out-of-scope line numbers) and a post-phase invariant that the out-of-scope count is byte-identical before and after. This converts the highest-probability failure mode -- a blanket regex substitution crossing the scope boundary -- into a checkable phase gate rather than relying on implementer care.
